en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from one of them<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww wore Ihraam in two cotton cloths’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “One of ’A’immah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, assumed the state of Ihram in two pieces of cotton fabric.’”
